our_source_edit: loom/include/loom/ring.h only; parent owns conditional Table controls and CMake
layout_proof: Cursor16, Slot size/alignment and function/next/Arguments offsets unchanged for five instantiated families; owner at old previous offset and previous at old inventory offset.
supported_callback_mutation_proof: Cursor carries the prepublished frontier pointer value, not a next link reread after a callback may append.
During spin, push appends membership without changing the non-null published Ring.next_ pointer value. complete marks a slot only.
finish captures the owner before retiring current, then resynchronizes frontier from authoritative owner.next_ after unlink or FIFO promotion. Empty returns without dereferencing a retired frontier.
Each admitted bank Slot has the stable same-Ring owner assigned once at configure. push does not overwrite owner; Ring is non-movable.
Every dispatch still restores Slot-stored Arguments. Remaining is decremented once per callback; budget exhaustion publishes zero, with all finish and promotion accounting at the original points.

Reentry/spin, release_if/discard, close, shared/policy refresh are forbidden or rejected within spin. Returned-boundary cancellation retains authoritative Ring.next_; next spin initializes a new Cursor from it.
cold_inventory: unsigned uintptr_t byte offset / sizeof(Slot), only retire and release_if; same fixed bank, no new Slot field or typed-array subtraction assumption
meaningful_oracle_coverage: Existing independent rotation model includes active widths, overflow widths, callback pushes from C1, accepted/refused inventory, exact finite/zero budgets, retirement with FIFO replacement and returned-boundary cancellation. Shared scalar/vector and unchanged-argument identities, Cohort and hint physical-window checks also pass.
costs_and_limits: Owner must still be loaded to publish Ring.next_ and for Cursor.operator->. Removal of the loop-carried Ring.next_ load is a mechanism claim, not a measured speedup.

Owner at offset24 in Slot56 extends the consumed prefix to32 bytes: on a64-byte-aligned bank,3/8 Slot prefixes straddle a line versus2/8 for original24-byte function/next/argument prefix. Two-pointer Slot64 owner at32.
Cold inventory derivation adds arithmetic during retirement/cancellation; can matter for short jobs or high retirement rates.
Slot.inventory is replaced in this private macro cut. No known production caller uses it; unchanged byte layout does not imply external source compatibility for that public structural field.
All executions local ARM VM, CPU0 pinned, against reused matching release/sanitized archives. No x86 execution, native timing, public runtime edit or promotion.
